name: Quantum Computing
boundaries: Quantum Computing: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: A scalable fault-tolerant computer with millions of logical qubits at low error
original_dispositions.reason: Extendable universal fault tolerance, a cryptographically sized execution, and bounded overhead stay separate. The exponential NP-hard clause is unsupported and is disposed under item 3.

original_dispositions.original_title: Room-temperature, long-coherence solid-state qubits with high fidelity
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by QUA-10 as a component, with the overlap flagged. A bare ambient qubit below a gate threshold is the ordinary component path toward QUA-01.

original_dispositions.original_title: An efficient quantum algorithm with exponential speedup for a useful NP-hard optimization problem
original_dispositions.reason: No missing mechanism was identified whose discovery would exponentially solve protein folding, logistics, or portfolio optimization. Bennett and collaborators report that, relative to a random oracle, NP “cannot be solved on a quantum Turing machine in time o(2^{n/2}),” a bound tight by Grover’s algorithm; this is an oracle result, not a proof that NP lies outside quantum polynomial time. Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/quant-ph/9701001. Structured speedups stay in QUA-02 and QUA-03.

original_dispositions.original_title: A global-scale quantum internet with entanglement over thousands of kilometers
original_dispositions.reason: The central advance is quantum communication: repeaters, key distribution, and sensor networks. The fault-tolerant inter-module link needed for computing is already QUA-06. No 2026 quantum-repeater distance or rate record was opened.

original_dispositions.original_title: Provably secure, efficient quantum homomorphic encryption for arbitrary circuits, information-theoretic or post-quantum
original_dispositions.reason: The cited information-theoretic no-go results report exponential overhead for the specified secure fully homomorphic schemes; see https://arxiv.org/abs/1406.2456, https://arxiv.org/abs/1705.00139, and https://arxiv.org/html/1809.08719v1. On the computational side, Broadbent and Jeffery, arXiv:1412.8766, give schemes that become inefficient as T-gate complexity grows. Brakerski’s abstract presents a scheme with comparable properties to classical FHE based on learning with errors, with LWE alone implying leveled QFHE and a further circular-security assumption for unbounded depth: https://eprint.iacr.org/2018/338. The PDF was not opened. The notes judge making its overhead comfortable on a future fault-tolerant machine incremental relative to the calibration bar.

original_dispositions.original_title: Topological qubits with high-fidelity braiding and scalable error correction
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by QUA-05. Scalable error correction in the active-decoding sense is QUA-01. The two are flagged and kept distinct.

original_dispositions.original_title: Chemical-accuracy simulation of industrially relevant molecules or materials on a few hundred logical qubits or on near-term devices
original_dispositions.reason: The qubit-count and near-term clauses are resource targets. A single FeMoco model energy is not split out, because Friesecke and collaborators already claim chemical accuracy for that model energy by a classical method: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38109339/.

original_dispositions.original_title: Quantum machine learning with a provable exponential speedup on real-world classical data
original_dispositions.reason: Tang’s dequantization of the recommendation-system candidate is inside QUA-09. A separate machine-learning ID would duplicate the data-loading problem.

original_dispositions.original_title: A self-correcting quantum memory at room temperature, with indefinite coherence and no active correction
original_dispositions.reason: Room temperature and indefinite lifetime are stricter operating points of the same passive thermal memory. The May 2026 construction is a mathematical Hamiltonian for one logical qubit, with perturbative stability deferred by its authors, and it states no ambient critical temperature.

original_dispositions.original_title: A fundamentally new quantum algorithm or computational model beyond the circuit model, with adiabatic, measurement-based, and hybrid models named as examples
original_dispositions.reason: The adiabatic model is polynomially equivalent to the standard model according to https://arxiv.org/html/quant-ph/0405098v2. The measurement-based model’s primary equivalence proof was not re-opened, so the disposition does not rest on a fresh reading of it. Hybrid variational models are the rejected noisy-algorithm program. The historical wording names no problem that the circuit model cannot already express. A future algorithm with a new exponential speedup would amend QUA-02, QUA-03, QUA-07, or QUA-09 according to the problem it solves.

reconciliation_change_log.reason: No new ID met the revolutionary-impact bar.
